## Commons contribution manifest

This is a proposed contribution for human review. A passing validator is not acceptance or permission to publish. Do not include personal testimony, private lore, secrets, credentials, code, scripts, or unlisted files.

The manifest must use [`contribution-0.1`](../../docs/commons/schema/contribution-0.1.schema.json) and live in one `commons/<id>/` folder whose name matches its manifest id. The current CI preflight accepts only fictional Tier 1 text contributions for a corridor alcove. A room manifest is not accepted here: `unheld.room/0.1` remains proposed under [ADR 0005](../../docs/ADR/0005-room-kit.md).

## Review checklist

- [ ] This pull request proposes one contribution in one `commons/<id>/` folder.
- [ ] All first-person writing is invented and the manifest declares `fiction: true`.
- [ ] No real person's testimony or identity is represented.
- [ ] Agent-made work names the human or organisation granting CC BY 4.0 as an author or supervisor.
- [ ] The work contains no executable content, web addresses, secrets, or private design material.
- [ ] The `commons:human-review` label is present for the human editorial, safety, provenance, and licence review.
